say:1:1320633001:0.text: Should I continue calling to my brother?
say:1:1320633001:0.source_cn: 我还要继续呼唤哥哥吗？

say:2:1320633002:0.text: Yes, as his most cherished relative, your voice must reach his soul.
say:2:1320633002:0.source_cn: 是的，作为他最珍重的血亲，你的声音必须要传达给他的灵魂。

say:3:1320633003:1.text: I understand. If that's the case, there is something I want to try.
say:3:1320633003:1.source_cn: 我明白了……如果是这样的话，我有想做的事情。

say:4:1320633004:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you please hand me "The Mage and the Adventurer"?
say:4:1320633004:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you please hand me "The Mage and the Adventurer"?
say:4:1320633004:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you please hand me "The Mage and the Adventurer"?

choice_prompt:5:1320633004.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you please hand me "The Mage and the Adventurer"?
choice_prompt:5:1320633004.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style><male>先生</male><female>小姐</female>，那本《魔法师与冒险家》，能先还给我吗？
choice_prompt:5:1320633004.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you please hand me "The Mage and the Adventurer"?
choice_prompt:5:1320633004.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you please hand me "The Mage and the Adventurer"?

say:6:1320633005:1.text: With this book, I will read aloud as we did in our childhood, but this time, I'll read to him instead.
say:6:1320633005:1.source_cn: 有了这本《魔法师与冒险家》，这次可以由我来为哥哥读书了...
say:6:1320633005:1.male: With this book, I will read aloud as we did in our childhood, but this time, I'll read to him instead.
say:6:1320633005:1.female: With this book, I will read aloud as we did in our childhood, but this time, I'll read to him instead.

say:7:1320633006:1.text: It won't be him telling me a tale but me sharing our story with him.
say:7:1320633006:1.source_cn: 这次，不是他来给我讲故事，而是我将属于我们的故事讲给他听。
say:7:1320633006:1.male: It won't be him telling me a tale but me sharing our story with him.
say:7:1320633006:1.female: It won't be him telling me a tale but me sharing our story with him.

say:11:1320633009:1.text: Carolina picks up the book and clears her throat.
say:11:1320633009:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜拿起故事书，清了清嗓子。

say:13:1320633010:1.text: "Once upon a time, there was a little adventurer who dreamed of exploring every corner of Esperia on her own two feet."
say:13:1320633010:1.source_cn: “在很久很久以前，有一个小小的冒险家，她很想用自己的双...

say:14:1320633011:1.text: "Meanwhile, there was a great mage well-versed in all spells in the world. He had a great sense of humor and a charming personality. On a dark, starless night, the great mage knocked on the little adventurer's door."
say:14:1320633011:1.source_cn: “有一位伟大的魔法师，他掌握世界上一切魔法，风趣又洒脱...

say:15:1320633012:1.text: "'I'll keep you safe,' the mage promised. 'I'll use magic to dispel all evil and clear every obstacle so you can have a joyful and safe journey.'"
say:15:1320633012:1.source_cn: “……那么，就让我来保护你吧，大魔法师说。我会用魔法替...

say:16:1320633013:1.text: "However, to his surprise, the little adventurer shook her head and said, 'I don't need your protection, Mr. Mage. My feet have crossed deep waters and been burned in cold frost. I have seen a lot, and I understand a lot.'"
say:16:1320633013:1.source_cn: “但是，出乎他的意料，小冒险家摇摇头：我不需要你的保护...

say:17:1320633014:1.text: "'So, what do you need me to do?' asked the great mage."
say:17:1320633014:1.source_cn: “那么，你还需要我做什么呢？大魔法师问道。”

say:18:1320633015:0.text: "'I need you to go on the journey with me, and we will face difficulties and obstacles together. We will climb mountains and cross rainbows side by side!' The little adventurer proclaimed."
say:18:1320633015:0.source_cn: “我需要——小冒险家大声说——你和我一起踏上旅程，我们...

cinematic_dialogue:22:1320634003:.text: ...they stopped at the end of the journey.
cinematic_dialogue:22:1320634003:.source_cn: 大魔法师和小冒险家在旅途终点停了下来

cinematic_dialogue:22:1320634004:.text: There was a small stone house.
cinematic_dialogue:22:1320634004:.source_cn: 那是一座小小的石头房子

cinematic_dialogue:22:1320634005:.text: There was a fireplace and some wood.
cinematic_dialogue:22:1320634005:.source_cn: 木柴发潮，壁炉上有烟灰的痕迹

cinematic_dialogue:22:1320634006:.text: They stretched in front of the fire.
cinematic_dialogue:22:1320634006:.source_cn: 他们在火焰前伸展疲惫的双脚

narration:24:130206410:0.text: With Ludovic's help, the soul fragments in Callan's remains are transferred to the mechanical body, and he finally regains consciousness.
narration:24:130206410:0.source_cn: 在柳博米尔的帮助下，铐兰遗骸中的灵魂碎片被转移到了机械...

choice:5:1:2.text: What are you planning to do?
choice:5:1:2.male: What are you planning to do?
choice:5:1:2.female: What are you planning to do?
